messages:
Anna P: Quick debrief from today's vendor sync — short thread so we don't lose the ask.
Anna P: H100 / H200 firmware transit looks OK but vendors flagged a small % of units hitting early thermal throttling in our lab runs. They want us to do a controlled SKU sweep before marketplace tag cut.
Raj K: ugh, do we have a list of affected images / drivers?
Sofia M: Not yet. Vendor said it's PAL-level microcode + a driver rollout. They expect a patch next week, could be hotfix.
Anna P: Action items I asked for: (1) exact firmware build numbers, (2) list of test SKU IDs that hit the regression, (3) ETA for patch + canary plan for customers.
Eli (hw-bot): build-report: h100-fw-2026-03-19 v2.1.3 — 12/120 tested showed higher thermals under sustained 4k sequence.
Raj K: Can we gate marketplace listings until the patch is validated? We should avoid pulling live listings after we tag.
Sofia M: We should avoid a hard block; propose a phased listing with a prominent "known issue" note and auto-fallback routing to a different SKU (B200/MI300) if throttling detected by infra.
Carlos T: +1 phased listing. Also suggest we add a "compatibility_label: thermal-risk" we can surface to SI partners so they don't recommend units for long-running batch inference.
Anna P: Good call. Carlos, can you coordinate wording with partner comms? Make it short: two-line callout and link to support KB.
Carlos T: On it. I'll draft and tag vendor for approval.
Raj K: On rollout: if patch arrives next week, can eng-runtime run a 48h canary on Dedicated before we update marketplace tags?
Sofia M: Yes — runtime can schedule a canary with 100k tokens/day sim and thermal telemetry. Need a start window though — requesting vendor patch ETA by Monday EOD.
Anna P: Also flagged cross-cloud listing timing: one cloud asked for a freeze window for their catalog ingest (they need 72h lead). If patch is late we need to push back the catalog push and notify their marketplace PMs.
Raj K: I'll draft the notify template. Short + explicit: "We're delaying H100 H200 marketplace tag by X to validate firmware patch; customers on dedicated will have automatic fallback; no action required unless you opted-in to early access."
Sofia M: For SI integrators — create a checklist: SKU IDs, driver bundle link, recommended runtime fallback, thermal telemetry dashboard link.
Anna P: Agree. Quick ask to everyone: please drop the checklist items into this thread by EOD so I can send consolidated doc to vendor and cloud PMs.
Eli (hw-bot): reminder: next vendor sync scheduled 1751290000 (Tue 09:00 PST)
Carlos T: Draft checklist items: SKU list, driver package URL, known issue note, canary plan with metrics (token throughput, 95p latency, thermal max), rollback criteria, customer comms snippet.
Raj K: Adding monitoring alerts: add threshold at +10C above baseline for sustained 5m, alert to oncall and partner-facing channel.
Sofia M: Also ensure KMS/HSM note for Private deployments if firmware touches attestation — vendor said attestation metadata will change.
Anna P: OK — final: I'll consolidate and ping cloud PMs + SI leads after we get vendor build numbers. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Carlos T: Drafted the comms snippet, dropping link: https://intranet.redwood/example-drafts (vendor approval required)
Anna P: Perfect. We'll reconvene after vendor update.
